main_text.head: SECT. XI. De Purgatorio.
main_text.p: EX satisfactionum opinione pendent & Purgatorij fabulæ, & Indulgentiarum: lepidæ profecto ambę,& iambis non indignæ: Quo de utroque opportunè mihi succurrit illud Lutheri σκῶμμα μαισ- ψικον, è Propheta excerptum: Domine, non possum vesci stercore humano: Quod si modò dubitanter & problematicè Purgatorium suum Ecclesiæ propinassent, facilè quidem nobis esset, conniuere: haud scio interibi, splenis-ne

page.notes: The Greek words in the text ("σκῶμμα μαισ-ψικον") are printed in small italic type and are only approximately legible; the last Greek word is doubtful. The catchword "po-" and the signature "H 4" are at the foot of the column. The line "splenis-ne" is cut off at the column edge; the word continues on the next page.
